# Resource: tfe_registry_artifact_tag

Provides a resource which manages the tags on registry artifacts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Basic usage

resource "tfe_registry_module" "example" {
  organization    = tfe_organization.example.name
  name            = "example_module"
  module_provider = "aws"
  registry_name   = "private"
}

resource "tfe_registry_artifact_tag" "example" {
  artifact = {
    type = "registry-module"
    id   = tfe_registry_module.example.id
  }

  tags = [
    {
      key   = "environment"
      value = "production"
    },
    {
      key   = "team"
      value = "platform"
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `Artifact` (Attributes) Object representing the registry artifact to be tagged. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--artifact))
- `Tags` (Attributes Set) The list of the project tags to assign to the registry artifact. This will replace all existing tags on the artifact. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `Id` (String) The ID of the tag binding.

<a id="nestedatt--artifact"></a>
### Nested Schema for `Artifact`

Required:

- `Id` (String) The ID of the registry artifact.
- `Type` (String) The type of the Registry Artifact.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `Tags`

Required:

- `Key` (String) The tag key.
- `Value` (String) The tag value.




## Import

Resource tfe_registry_artifact_tag can be imported in the following format: 

```shell
# via <ARTIFACT TYPE>/<ARTIFACT ID>
terraform import tfe_registry_artifact_tag.example registry-module/mod-eJmXhLS5DdUAdVSw
```
